arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog has been growing all week, with 1204 failed jobs as of 12 minutes ago. The primary database shows a higher count of failed jobs, indicating potential issues. The intermediate certificate for pgbouncer expired and was manually replaced. Cron jobs were running on UTC, causing a misalignment in the schedule. The 502s on the checkout page were due to the ingress idle timeout, not a database issue.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Restart cron to correct the schedule, update the intermediate certificate for pgbouncer, and investigate the cause of the failed jobs to prevent future issues.
